name: Air Data
tagline: Air quality for every US county, from 1980 to yesterday.
description: The daily Air Quality Index for every US county with an EPA monitor, joining EPA's validated history to the preliminary days since its last release, plus yearly county summaries. Each row says whether it is validated or preliminary.

name: Carbon Data
tagline: Open, versioned emission factors for carbon accounting.
description: Scope 1, 2 and 3 emission factors in consistent units, with permanent versioned URLs that auditors can cite. Facility and company emissions to follow.

name: Climate Data
tagline: Clean climate data for every US county and the world, updated monthly.
description: Monthly temperature and precipitation for every US county since 1895, with normals, anomalies and rankings, plus the global temperature and greenhouse-gas records. Free JSON, CSV and Parquet downloads and an open API.

name: Economic Data
tagline: US regional and international economic data in one consistent schema.
description: Unemployment for every US state, county and metro area since 1976, county jobs and wages, county income, and GDP, inflation and population for every country. Every number keeps its source, and every version stays citable.

name: Election Data
tagline: Election results with every number traced to its source.
description: Every US Senate election from 1976 to 2024, one row per candidate, with county presidential and House history and certified 2026 results to follow. Each row keeps the source it came from.

name: Health Data
tagline: Overdose deaths and health insurance for every US state and county.
description: CDC's provisional drug overdose deaths for every state, by drug, and every county, updated monthly, and the Census Bureau's estimates of who lacks health insurance in every county and state since 2008.

name: Housing Data
tagline: Home prices and new construction for every US county.
description: FHFA's house price index for every county and state since 1975, and the Census Bureau's building permits for every county since 1990: how fast home values have risen and how much new housing is being built where you live.

name: Justice Data
tagline: Crime in every US state, from the FBI's national statistics.
description: The crimes reported by police in every state each month since 2018, from the FBI's Crime Data Explorer: violent and property offenses, how many were cleared, and how much of each state's population those reports cover.

name: Satellite Data
tagline: A unified, up-to-date catalog of every object in orbit.
description: One record per object since Sputnik, with owner, orbit and status, the newest orbital elements for everything the US Space Force tracks, and a log of every launch. Ready for the new 6-digit catalog numbers.

name: Visualize Data
tagline: Charts, maps and embeds built from the whole data family.
description: The chart and map layer for climatedata, economicdata, electiondata and the other sites: ready-made visualizations, embeddable charts and shared map boundaries.

name: Water Data
tagline: Daily streamflow at every active US stream gage, and drought by county.
description: Daily mean flow for the last 400 days at every active USGS stream gage, with approval and ice flags, plus weekly US Drought Monitor categories for every county. Built on the new USGS Water Data APIs: a stable replacement for scripts that used the legacy WaterServices API.

name: Wildfire Data
tagline: Active fires from satellites, linked to official incidents and perimeters.
description: Satellite fire detections grouped into fires and matched to the official incident name, size, containment and perimeter, with a daily smoke overlay. Updated every 3 hours.
